situation:
You are to assume the role of marketing manager of COMMONS FIRE GRILL, a quick-serve operator with three restaurants on the campus of a large state university. The president (judge) has asked you to recommend whether the company should change the way its food is cooked.

Commons Fire Grill has fed the campus for eighteen years. Every order is grilled over an open flame on a line the guest can watch from the queue, and that open flame is what students photograph, tag, and save when they share where to eat on campus. The company's promotion has been built on it for years.

A new competitor, BOWL LAB, opened in the student union last fall with conveyor ovens and a ninety-second ticket time. Commons Fire Grill's noon wait now runs eleven minutes, its grill line cannot cook any faster at peak, and lunch traffic has moved to Bowl Lab for two straight terms.

The president (judge) wants a recommendation. Replacing the grill line with conveyor ovens would roughly triple what the kitchen can send out at noon, but it would end the open-flame cooking guests watch from the queue and take away the thing students photograph and tag. Keeping the grill line and adding a second one for the peak hour protects that, but the noon wait stays near eleven minutes and lunch traffic keeps moving to Bowl Lab.

You will present your recommendation to the president (judge) in the president's (judge) office. The president (judge) will begin by greeting you and asking to hear your ideas. After you have presented and have answered the president's (judge) questions, the president (judge) will thank you for your work.
judgeCharacterization:
You are to assume the role of president of COMMONS FIRE GRILL. Business background is the same as the situation above.

You have asked the marketing manager (participant) to recommend whether the company should change the way its food is cooked. You want to hear what happens to the students who wait at noon, what the company keeps or gives up in the open-flame cooking its promotion has been built on, and what either choice means for the traffic Bowl Lab has been taking.

During the course of the role-play you are to ask the participant the following questions:
judgeQuestions: What does the first month of this change look like?
Who on the crew has to be told, and when?
